# RunWield

> RunWield is a plan- and lifecycle-centered coding harness that turns a rough idea into a collaborative Plan, deliberate execution, validation, and a durable Work Record.

RunWield is for developers using AI on real codebases where intent, risk, and proof matter more than typing speed. It is not a pull-request review bot or an autonomous vibe-coding tool. Its current public surfaces include the `wld` CLI and TUI, browser-based Plan Review, and guided Code Review.

Core workflow: rough idea -> collaborative Plan -> deliberate execution -> validation -> Work Record -> better future planning.

RunWield is source-available and free to use, but it is not open source yet. Consult the repository license before redistributing or modifying it.

## Product

- [RunWield README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gandazgul/runwield/main/README.md): Product overview, installation, workflow, architecture, current status, and license summary.
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gandazgul/runwield/main/docs/quickstart.md): Install RunWield, connect a model provider, initialize a project, and run the first task.
- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gandazgul/runwield/main/docs/index.md): Entry point for the complete RunWield documentation.

## Workflows

- [Plans and workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gandazgul/runwield/main/docs/workflows.md): How RunWield classifies work, creates Plans, executes approved changes, validates results, and records outcomes.
- [Collaboration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gandazgul/runwield/main/docs/collaboration.md): Human-agent collaboration modes and review checkpoints.
- [Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gandazgul/runwield/main/docs/settings.md): Configuration and model-provider settings.
- [Customization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gandazgul/runwield/main/docs/customization.md): Project and user customization, agents, prompts, skills, and themes.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gandazgul/runwield/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): Common installation and runtime problems.
